title: Coordinate permutation of a decision tree
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\alpha$ be types, let $n$ be a natural number, let $A\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ be the available coordinates, and let $\sigma$ be a permutation of $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$. The coordinate-permuted tree has available set $\sigma(A)$; each query at coordinate $i$ becomes a query at $\sigma(i)$, with the same label-dependent branches, recursively permuted.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a set of available coordinates among $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$
The input tree is a finite decision tree over $\Omega$ with labels in $\alpha$ and available set $A$
